title: Selora AI Insights Export Envelope
description: The gzipped JSON document referenced by manifest.artifact.path. A full snapshot of the home's device-plane health each publish.

signals.description: Active Layer-1 health signals, deduped per (kind, target).

insights.description: Deterministic advisor items derived from signals + patterns.

health.description: The deterministic 0-100 health score and the per-check roll-up explaining it. Optional (additive to v2); absent on older producers, treat as an unknown score. The per-finding contribution rows behind the score are intentionally NOT exported — that detail is available per-target in 'signals' and 'roster'.

score.description: 100 = nothing flagged. null means no audit has run yet — read as UNKNOWN, not as healthy.

band.description: Letter band for the score: A >=90, B >=80, C >=70, D >=60, else F. Empty string when score is null.

computed_at.description: When the audit behind this score ran (VM clock). Refreshes at the health-scan cadence, which is independent of the export cadence — so it normally predates the envelope's generated_at.

device_penalty.description: Points subtracted by per-device outages (scales with the sqrt of the share of the fleet affected).

other_penalty.description: Points subtracted by integration errors, automation hygiene, and updates (fixed-severity, diminishing returns).

affected.description: Affected devices counted (deduped, one per device at its worst severity).

size.description: Active-fleet denominator: devices that could actually produce a finding.

fraction.description: Severity-weighted affected share of the fleet, clamped to 1.0.

sections.description: Per-check roll-up of the score impact, biggest first — one row per check rather than one per finding.

title.description: The check's section title, e.g. 'Devices offline'.

device_id.description: Device the target belongs to when target_kind is 'entity'; null for device/integration targets or entities with no device.

homeRoster.description: Full device-plane inventory: what's running and what's not.

truncated.description: True when the entity list hit the per-publish cap.

name.description: Human integration name from its manifest (e.g. 'National Weather Service (NWS)'). Consumers label by name → title → domain; empty when unresolved.

custom.description: True when the integration is a custom component (not built into Home Assistant).

url.description: Manifest documentation URL (integration docs page); empty string when unknown.

version.description: Integration manifest version. Populated for custom components; empty for core integrations, which are unversioned and track producer.ha_version. Optional (additive to v2).

apps.description: Installed Supervisor apps (formerly 'add-ons'). Present only on supervised installs; empty array on Core/Container installs. Optional (additive to v2); absent on older producers, treat as [].

version.description: Installed version; empty string when the Supervisor reported none.

version_latest.description: Latest available version; empty string when unknown.

url.description: App homepage / management URL, credential-stripped; empty string when none.

repository_name.description: Name of the store the app was installed from (e.g. 'Home Assistant Community Store'); empty string when unknown. Optional (additive to v2).

repository_url.description: URL of that store, credential-stripped; empty string for the built-in 'core' and 'local' stores, which have none. Optional (additive to v2).

repository_maintainer.description: Maintainer of that store; empty string when unknown. Optional (additive to v2).

unavailable_entities.description: Count of ENABLED, visible entities on the device with no usable state (genuinely unavailable). Excludes disabled and hidden entities — a disabled entity is intentionally off, not broken.

disabled_entities.description: Count of intentionally-disabled entities on the device. Neutral (like HA's '+N disabled'), not a health problem.

url.description: Device configuration_url (e.g. an add-on's homepage / management page); empty string when the device has none.

transient.description: True when EVERY integration backing the device is a transient BLE beacon / presence-advert source (ibeacon, private_ble_device, bluetooth_le_tracker, ble_monitor, bermuda). Such devices go unavailable simply when out of range and are often not the user's — consumers should drop them from the 'needs attention' tally and default device view (behind a toggle). Optional (additive to v2); absent on older producers, treat as false.

device_id.description: Device this entity belongs to; null if it has no device.
